cases.sentence: Долго еще вам мучить меня и своими словами меня ___?
cases.translation: How long will you torment me and crush me with words?
cases.explain: The verb мучить requires an infinitive (терзать) in this construction.

cases.sentence: Вот уже десять раз вы меня ___.
cases.translation: You have reproached me ten times.
cases.explain: The context indicates past tense (десять раз = ten times already).

cases.sentence: Бог причинил мне ___ и сеть свою на меня набросил.
cases.translation: God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
cases.explain: The verb причинил (caused) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: I cry for help, but there is no justice.
cases.explain: The word нет (there is no) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он исторг надежду мою, как ___, воспылал на меня гнев его.
cases.translation: He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
cases.explain: The preposition как (like) in this comparison requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он удалил моих братьев от ___, и близкие люди стали чужими.
cases.translation: He has put my brothers far from me.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always requires genitive case.

cases.sentence: Гости мои и мои служанки считают меня ___.
cases.translation: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger.
cases.explain: The verb считают (consider) takes instrumental case for the predicate noun.

cases.sentence: Искупитель мой жив, и в конце он встанет над ___.
cases.translation: I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition над (above) requires instrumental case.

reading.ru: Долго еще вам мучить меня и своими словами меня терзать?
reading.question: What does Job ask his friends regarding their treatment of him?
options: How long will they continue to torment him with words
Why are they not helping him
What do they know about his suffering
reading.correct: How long will they continue to torment him with words
reading.explain: Job asks долго еще (how long still) they will мучить меня (torment him) with their words.

reading.ru: Если я и впрямь согрешил, при мне мой грех и останется.
reading.question: What does Job say about his guilt?
options: If he has sinned, it is his concern alone
reading.correct: If he has sinned, it is his concern alone
reading.explain: Job states если я согрешил (if I have sinned), при мне мой грех (my sin remains with me).

reading.ru: Бог причинил мне зло и сеть свою на меня набросил.
reading.question: According to Job, what has God done to him?
options: Caused him harm and surrounded him with a net
reading.correct: Caused him harm and surrounded him with a net
reading.explain: Job says Бог причинил мне зло (God caused me harm) and сеть свою набросил (cast his net on me).

reading.ru: Он крушит меня со всех сторон, я ухожу.
reading.question: How does Job describe his current condition?
options: God is crushing him from all sides and he is departing
reading.correct: God is crushing him from all sides and he is departing
reading.explain: Job says He крушит меня со всех сторон (crushes me on every side), я ухожу (I am gone).

reading.ru: Когда моя кожа с меня спадет, я все же воплоти моей увижу Бога.
reading.question: What does Job express faith about regarding his future?
options: Even after death, he will see God in his flesh
He will find justice from his friends
reading.correct: Even after death, he will see God in his flesh
reading.explain: Job declares когда моя кожа спадет (when my skin falls away), он все же воплоти моей увижу Бога (I will still see God in my flesh).

reading.ru: О, если бы записаны были мои слова, были бы в свитке начертаны!
reading.question: What is Job's wish regarding his words?
options: He wishes his words were written down in a scroll
He regrets what he has said
He hopes his friends will listen
reading.correct: He wishes his words were written down in a scroll
reading.explain: Job says если бы записаны были мои слова (if only my words were written) в свитке начертаны (inscribed in a scroll).
